sloka: अथ प्रदीप्तैर्नाराचैर्मुसलैश्चापि रावणः ।अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं धाराभिरिव तोयदः ।। ६.१०१.५९ ।।
transliteration: atha pradīptairnārācairmusalaiścāpi rāvaṇaḥ ।abhyavarṣattadā rāmaṁ dhārābhiriva toyadaḥ ।। 6.101.59 ।।

translations.english: Shattered and scattered, those arrows of Rama and of Ravana, their points ablaze, fell from the sky upon the earth.
